Cookie Policy

What browser storage SimplyHow currently uses, and how third-party services may differ.

Last updated: November 5, 2026

This Cookie Policy explains the site's current use of cookies and browser storage. Read it with our Privacy Policy.

What a cookie is

A cookie is a small text file a website asks your browser to store on your device. It lets the site remember something between pages or visits - a preference, a login, or simply the fact that you have already answered a question. Cookies cannot read arbitrary files on your device and cannot carry viruses by themselves.

Related technologies - local storage, pixels and device identifiers - work similarly, and this policy covers them too.

What this site uses

The current site code does not set cookies or read or write browser local storage. It does not currently load analytics or advertising services. The web host may process technical requests to deliver and protect the site; check the host's privacy documentation for its use of cookies and server logs. Some article images are hosted by third parties, whose servers receive a request when your browser loads an image.

If analytics or advertising services are enabled later, this policy will be updated before they are used. Third-party advertising providers, including Google, may use cookies to serve ads based on previous visits to this or other websites. Users can manage personalized ads in Google Ads Settings or visit YourAdChoices. We will provide a legally and geographically appropriate consent solution before serving ads that require consent.

Third-party cookies

External links and remotely hosted images may involve third-party requests. Any cookies or storage those providers use are governed by their own policies.

How to control cookies

You can review, block, or delete cookies in your browser's privacy settings. Blocking cookies may affect other websites and services.

Do Not Track

There is no agreed industry standard for responding to browser Do Not Track signals, so the site does not currently change its behavior when it receives one.

Updates to this policy

When the site's use of cookies or storage changes, we will update this policy and the date shown in the page header.

Contact

Questions about cookies or your choices: see our Contact page.
